hypothesis: CE hashing, HMAC, ciphers, GCM through CE AES plus CPU GHASH, conditioned TRNG requests, authenticated inputs and CPU-staging erasure behave as specified on the host.

conditions.evidence: digest, staging, native input and upload-erasure checks under ~/.cache/sunstoneos/build/security-1031/; earlier mode evidence in crypto-modes-20261028/ and fixed CE400 provisioning evidence in ce-clock-20261020/root-integration.json, relative to ~/.cache/sunstoneos/evidence/

narrative: Covered: SHA and HMAC, MD5 and SM3 (the older component statement that MD5/SM3 preparation is refused is superseded by its integrated producer section and the current digest checks), AES ECB, CBC and CTR, GCM through CE AES plus CPU GHASH, conditioned TRNG requests, authenticated inputs and CPU-staging erasure. SID reads four ID words. Launch is blocked on predecessor-DMA accounting, exclusion of future secure and nonsecure clients, secure-bank access, reachable private memory, IRQ and drain and stable ownership; the application polls once per tick with INTIDs 200 and 201 masked, parks until power removal and has no CE-specific returning watchdog contract. Only conditioned TRNG output is documented: no A733 raw-source export or startup completion counter is established, and other sunxi-trng layouts do not establish the selected CE node's behavior. Native CE GCM and further AES modes, DES/3DES/SM4/RC4, RSA/ECC/SM2, PRNG/DRBG, key-ladder operations, eFuse provisioning and mutable secure storage are not implemented; internal key erasure is unproven.
